caps_title: Two things we bring to every industry
caps_lede: Whatever your sector, these are the two ways we most often change how an organisation runs.
twin_body: A live model of your plant, network or facility, fed by sensors and operating data, so you can see its condition, test changes and plan maintenance before anything fails.
twin_outcome: Fewer surprise breakdowns, safer changes, and decisions tested before they cost money.

dt_outcome: One version of the truth, faster approvals, and teams that spend time on the work instead of re-entering it.
